LSN-2026-CHAPTER-5-PROSE-ONLY-INVARIANT-.statement: Chapter 5 must strictly contain zero tables (Markdown or Word). All tables belong exclusively in Chapter 4.
LSN-2026-CHAPTER-5-PROSE-ONLY-INVARIANT-.violation_message: Chapter 5 must strictly contain zero tables (Markdown or Word). All tables belong exclusively in Chapter 4.
LSN-2026-CHAPTER-5-PROSE-ONLY-INVARIANT-.remedy: Remove markdown tables from Chapter 5 and synthesize findings into continuous theoretical prose.

AP-2026-BOLD-TABLE-CAPTIONS.statement: Remove bold weight from table captions. Ensure font is B Nazanin, size 12 pt, Regular.
AP-2026-BOLD-TABLE-CAPTIONS.pattern: Presence of bold styling applied to paragraph styles or runs explicitly acting as Table Captions.
AP-2026-BOLD-TABLE-CAPTIONS.violation_message: Remove bold weight from table captions. Ensure font is B Nazanin, size 12 pt, Regular.
AP-2026-BOLD-TABLE-CAPTIONS.remedy: Remove bold weight from table captions. Ensure font is B Nazanin, size 12 pt, Regular.

AP-2026-INLINE-COLON-LISTICLES.statement: Avoid telegraphic inline feature labels followed by colons inside body paragraphs.
AP-2026-INLINE-COLON-LISTICLES.violation_message: Telegraphic inline colon listicles detected inside body paragraphs.
AP-2026-INLINE-COLON-LISTICLES.remedy: Transform label-colon pairs into continuous scholarly prose with transitional connectives.

LSN-2026-STRUCTURAL-REFERENCE-PARSING-00.statement: Reference extraction and bibliography compilation must strictly exclude document subheadings, chapter titles, and non-reference text blocks from bibliography lists.
LSN-2026-STRUCTURAL-REFERENCE-PARSING-00.violation_message: Non-reference text or subheading leaked into bibliography or reference artifact.
LSN-2026-STRUCTURAL-REFERENCE-PARSING-00.remedy: Strip document subheadings and chapter headers before emitting reference list. Validate publication year in parentheses or standard bibliographic markers.

AP-2026-NAIVE-LENGTH-REFERENCE-PARSING.statement: Implement robust structural parsing using regex patterns that match specific citation components (e.g., publication year in parentheses, DOI links, standard APA 7 formatting) or use a dedicated reference parser rather than character count.
AP-2026-NAIVE-LENGTH-REFERENCE-PARSING.violation_message: Implement robust structural parsing using regex patterns that match specific citation components (e.g., publication year in parentheses, DOI links, standard APA 7 formatting) or use a dedicated reference parser rather than character count.
AP-2026-NAIVE-LENGTH-REFERENCE-PARSING.remedy: Implement robust structural parsing using regex patterns that match specific citation components (e.g., publication year in parentheses, DOI links, standard APA 7 formatting) or use a dedicated reference parser rather than character count.

LSN-2026-DOM-PARSING-FOR-OPENXML-MODIFIC.statement: Strictly ban regex string substitutions on minified XML. Mandate structured XML DOM parsing via lxml or ElementTree for all OpenXML modifications. Mandate mechanical body paragraph count verification (> 0) before release.
LSN-2026-DOM-PARSING-FOR-OPENXML-MODIFIC.violation_message: Strictly ban regex string substitutions on minified XML. Mandate structured XML DOM parsing via lxml or ElementTree for all OpenXML modifications. Mandate mechanical body paragraph count verification (> 0) before release.
LSN-2026-DOM-PARSING-FOR-OPENXML-MODIFIC.remedy: Strictly ban regex string substitutions on minified XML. Mandate structured XML DOM parsing via lxml or ElementTree for all OpenXML modifications. Mandate mechanical body paragraph count verification (> 0) before release.

LSN-2026-EXPLICIT-RIGHT-ALIGNMENT-AND-IN.statement: Mandatory: 1) Inject explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' for all Persian headings. 2) Tokenize inline Markdown into OpenXML '<w:i/>' / '<w:b/>' runs with zero raw asterisks in '<w:t>'.
LSN-2026-EXPLICIT-RIGHT-ALIGNMENT-AND-IN.violation_message: Mandatory: 1) Inject explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' for all Persian headings. 2) Tokenize inline Markdown into OpenXML '<w:i/>' / '<w:b/>' runs with zero raw asterisks in '<w:t>'.
LSN-2026-EXPLICIT-RIGHT-ALIGNMENT-AND-IN.remedy: Mandatory: 1) Inject explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' for all Persian headings. 2) Tokenize inline Markdown into OpenXML '<w:i/>' / '<w:b/>' runs with zero raw asterisks in '<w:t>'.

AP-2026-AMBIGUOUS-STACKED-REGRESSION-COE.statement: Add 'متغیر ملاک' as Column 1, listing 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی' on the first row of Model 1 and 'رفتارهای خودکشی' on the first row of Model 2.
AP-2026-AMBIGUOUS-STACKED-REGRESSION-COE.pattern: Detect any regression coefficients table with multiple 'ثابت' rows lacking a 'متغیر ملاک' column.
AP-2026-AMBIGUOUS-STACKED-REGRESSION-COE.violation_message: Add 'متغیر ملاک' as Column 1, listing 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی' on the first row of Model 1 and 'رفتارهای خودکشی' on the first row of Model 2.
AP-2026-AMBIGUOUS-STACKED-REGRESSION-COE.remedy: Add 'متغیر ملاک' as Column 1, listing 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی' on the first row of Model 1 and 'رفتارهای خودکشی' on the first row of Model 2.

AP-2026-B-TITR-OVERUSE.statement: Replace B Titr with B Nazanin for all elements except chapter names. Set body font to 14 pt, table fonts to 12 pt. Replace w:br with w:p.
AP-2026-B-TITR-OVERUSE.pattern: Presence of B Titr in table cells, captions, or any non-Chapter 1/2/3/4/5 title.
AP-2026-B-TITR-OVERUSE.violation_message: Replace B Titr with B Nazanin for all elements except chapter names. Set body font to 14 pt, table fonts to 12 pt. Replace w:br with w:p.
AP-2026-B-TITR-OVERUSE.remedy: Replace B Titr with B Nazanin for all elements except chapter names. Set body font to 14 pt, table fonts to 12 pt. Replace w:br with w:p.

AP-2026-BLANK-LINE-BETWEEN-TABLE-AND-NOT.statement: Place *یادداشت immediately on the next line without an empty line in Markdown. In DOCX generation, attach the note paragraph directly with tight space_before (0-2 pt) and no intervening empty paragraph.
AP-2026-BLANK-LINE-BETWEEN-TABLE-AND-NOT.pattern: Detection of a blank/empty paragraph or \n\n sequence immediately preceding a table note.
AP-2026-BLANK-LINE-BETWEEN-TABLE-AND-NOT.violation_message: Place *یادداشت immediately on the next line without an empty line in Markdown. In DOCX generation, attach the note paragraph directly with tight space_before (0-2 pt) and no intervening empty paragraph.
AP-2026-BLANK-LINE-BETWEEN-TABLE-AND-NOT.remedy: Place *یادداشت immediately on the next line without an empty line in Markdown. In DOCX generation, attach the note paragraph directly with tight space_before (0-2 pt) and no intervening empty paragraph.

AP-2026-BULLETED-ACADEMIC-NARRATIVE.statement: Synthesize points into continuous, cohesive scholarly prose using transition words instead of lists.
AP-2026-BULLETED-ACADEMIC-NARRATIVE.pattern: High frequency of <w:numPr> or bullet characters (•, -, 1.) in standard body narrative paragraphs.
AP-2026-BULLETED-ACADEMIC-NARRATIVE.violation_message: Synthesize points into continuous, cohesive scholarly prose using transition words instead of lists.
AP-2026-BULLETED-ACADEMIC-NARRATIVE.remedy: Synthesize points into continuous, cohesive scholarly prose using transition words instead of lists.

AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-MULTIPLE-LOGISTIC-T.statement: For any hypothesis containing simple, multiple, and logistic regressions, generate exactly 7 tables: 1 correlation table, and 2 tables for each of the 3 regressions (Model Summary/ANOVA or Omnibus Fit + Coefficients/Equation parameters).
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-MULTIPLE-LOGISTIC-T.pattern: Detection of fewer than 7 tables in a mixed simple/multiple/logistic regression hypothesis block, or detection of combined ANOVA/Coefficients columns in a single table structure.
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-MULTIPLE-LOGISTIC-T.violation_message: For any hypothesis containing simple, multiple, and logistic regressions, generate exactly 7 tables: 1 correlation table, and 2 tables for each of the 3 regressions (Model Summary/ANOVA or Omnibus Fit + Coefficients/Equation parameters).
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-MULTIPLE-LOGISTIC-T.remedy: For any hypothesis containing simple, multiple, and logistic regressions, generate exactly 7 tables: 1 correlation table, and 2 tables for each of the 3 regressions (Model Summary/ANOVA or Omnibus Fit + Coefficients/Equation parameters).

AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-REGRESSION-TABLE.statement: Decompose each regression reporting block into the mandatory 3 tables: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-REGRESSION-TABLE.pattern: Absence of ANOVA sum of squares or Correlation matrix in regression reporting blocks, or detection of a single table row containing both model summary (R2/F) and coefficient estimates (Beta/t).
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-REGRESSION-TABLE.violation_message: Decompose each regression reporting block into the mandatory 3 tables: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).
AP-2026-CONSOLIDATED-REGRESSION-TABLE.remedy: Decompose each regression reporting block into the mandatory 3 tables: Table 1 (Correlations), Table 2 (ANOVA & Model Summary), Table 3 (Coefficients & Collinearity).

AP-2026-CONVERSATIONAL-LANGUAGE-BLEED.statement: Decouple artifact target language from conversational orchestration language. After parsing non-English artifacts, the agent must deliberately switch its conversational output language back to English before emitting messages to the user. All user-facing turns must be strictly in English as mandated by Directive 6.
AP-2026-CONVERSATIONAL-LANGUAGE-BLEED.pattern: Detection of non-English characters in orchestration or conversational reports.
AP-2026-CONVERSATIONAL-LANGUAGE-BLEED.violation_message: Decouple artifact target language from conversational orchestration language. After parsing non-English artifacts, the agent must deliberately switch its conversational output language back to English before emitting messages to the user. All user-facing turns must be strictly in English as mandated by Directive 6.
AP-2026-CONVERSATIONAL-LANGUAGE-BLEED.remedy: Decouple artifact target language from conversational orchestration language. After parsing non-English artifacts, the agent must deliberately switch its conversational output language back to English before emitting messages to the user. All user-facing turns must be strictly in English as mandated by Directive 6.

AP-2026-CORRELATION-TABLE-SINGLE-LABEL-C.pattern: Detect correlation table whose columns before '۱' is less than 3.
